findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, msg_box, msg_inbox, agents_readiness, email_validate, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, deps_check, deps_audit · Private data: token_verdict, msg_box, agents_readiness, dns, domain, web_tables, sec_filings, federal_register_search, deps_audit, empresas · Public sink: msg_send, guard_injection, dns, domain, email_validate, deps_check, empresas_buscar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, msg_box, msg_inbox, agents_readiness, email_validate, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, deps_check, deps_audit · Private data: token_verdict, msg_box, agents_readiness, dns, domain, web_tables, sec_filings, federal_register_search, deps_audit, empresas · Public sink: msg_send, guard_injection, dns, domain, email_validate, deps_check, empresas_buscar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
